svg.title: YT-Duo application architecture
svg.desc: The Tkinter GUI offers verified-paste Auto download and mutually exclusive Options and Terminal panels, using a worker and event bridge; the CLI calls the same engine. Shared settings and selectors drive yt-dlp access, FFmpeg processing, FFprobe validation and local completion records. Separate GUI services probe metadata and check GitHub releases. Dashed arrows show service or event paths.

g.text: One engine. Two ways to download.
Desktop and terminal interfaces share selection, processing and verification.
Download work off the UI thread
Events return to the Tk event pump
Chosen output folder · config.json · media / format / bitrate archives
Verified sources removed · legacy recycle cleared on launch.
Solid: work / data · Dashed: background services / returned results
Windows: bundled Python, media tools + Deno. Unix: source + installed tools.
